decisions.rationale: Locked primary target: systematically beat Version 9 baseline (0.584 Public AUC) before scaling to leaderboard medal tiers.
C++ accelerated dicomsdl decoding with pydicom fallback achieves sub-3ms slice I/O.
ThreadPoolExecutor concurrency prevents I/O bottlenecks during multi-slice DICOM series loading.
Direction cosine cross-product normal vector mathematically identifies Sagittal, Coronal, and Axial planes.
Contiguous 3-channel slice slabs capture 2.5D inter-slice context without heavy 3D volumetric compute overhead.
Linear tissue windowing and dynamic 0.5-99.5 percentile clipping strictly normalize pixel arrays to [0.0, 1.0].
Multi-label Stratified Group K-Fold split guarantees 0% StudyInstanceUID leakage across folds while preserving rare pathology balance.
Exact unweighted Macro ROC AUC across all 12 classes calculated on continuous probabilities without destructive threshold binarization.
MetricTracker logs granular per-class AUC breakdowns and generates diagnostic summary reports to prevent silent regression.
